assets.prompt: Create a photorealistic educational editorial photograph for an AI engineering textbook about image inputs and spatial structure. Wide landscape 16:9. A close overhead view of a real pale wooden desk: one navy ceramic coffee mug with a clearly visible curved handle, one closed silver notebook computer, one small leafy plant in a white pot, and a folded textured cloth. Soft natural side light, tactile surfaces and subtle shadows, believable proportions and strong spatial relationships. This is an example image to discuss objects, edges, texture, position and variation in lighting, not a diagram. Restrained colors harmonious with ink navy #0B1F3A, blue #1F4E9C and paper #F4F6FA. No text, no labels, no arrows, no charts, no logos, no robot, no watermark. Crisp clear objects with generous spacing, high-quality photography.
